explication: LibreChat is a self-hostable AI chat application supporting multiple model providers, Agents and tools, file workflows, and chat features such as search, artifacts, and audio. A typical user submits a prompt in the chat UI; the client sends requests and handles streamed events while the server coordinates model runs and returns results. The map includes major documented capabilities as well as sampled streaming, agent-trigger, file, and scheduling internals. Several subsystem links are based on README descriptions rather than sampled call sites, so those are marked dashed.
